materials.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a production top-down game ROAD SECTION with fully designed edges, not a square fill texture. Reference image: original Safety Last camp path, strict guide for painted shapes, brushwork, earthy colours, stone scale and depth. Create one portrait 2:3 image. A straight vertical path runs continuously through the top and bottom edges, centred and about 42% of the canvas width. The road has irregular naturally broken side edges and a broad tapered soil shoulder on each side. All outside area fades into genuine transparent alpha; no rectangular ground background. Keep the centre line straight so the game can bend the whole section along its routes. Top and bottom must connect seamlessly when repeated. High quality crisp hand-painted illustration; exact overhead view, soft consistent upper-left light, small contact shadows, no photograph, no gritty photoreal noise, no embossed material. No grass, plants, leaves, roots, props, puddles, text or UI. Design edge detail at the same importance as road centre. Primary request: extend the ORIGINAL CAMP STONE WALKWAY, with 4–5 irregular cream, pale grey and warm sandstone cobbles across the paved width. Each boundary stone is complete with an irregular silhouette; do not slice stones with a straight road mask and do not fade the stones themselves. Stones subtly bed into warm ochre earth, narrow deep brown gaps, modest soft lower-right contact shadows, flat slightly rough clean faces. Include displaced tiny chips and compacted warm earth immediately outside the stone edges, scattered partly buried smaller stones tapering into the transparent soil shoulders. Avoid bright glossy pillow cobbles and heavy black outlines. The path and its soil bedding should feel painted together like the original camp.

Full path and soil shoulder designed together, subdued contrast, small hand-painted angular pebbles like the reference.
